en: You are now ready to follow the path that joins your life with my own, if only for a short time. However we must make sure that you understand the things of which the spirits speak.

Are you really surprised? Is it hard to believe that the power of an Old God could reach even inside the Dream? It is true - Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream, wages a battle against us all. The Nightmare follows in his wake of destruction.
Arnok makes good bandages.  Find him at the Survival of the Fittest hut on the shore of the lake next to Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  It's above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.
The Sarkhoff's... sometimes the Sarkhoff's visit. They are good people.
Protect the Magistrate at all costs. They could come from any direction!
Pathetic...
The first steps of our fight against the Scourge go well. We have had some successes, and hopefully my assistance can aid you in bringing future success to the battle.
Stop!  Infidels!
Shenthul, I have lost my whistle and I have no more flares. Please help!
There must be someplace on Azeroth that we can find oozes uncorrupted by the Scourge or anything else. But where?!
%s carefully studies Sara Balloo's note and lets out a long, solemn sigh.

Welcome to Stormwind!  I am one of the city's officers, aiding the citizenry of the city through our census bureau.  If you are in need of locating someone specific, then I might be able to assist you.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.$B$BIf you have business with me, then please proceed!
Oh, do tell! The suspense alone is enough to make a girl scream!
I present you with proof of my deeds, Cyrus.
Good day, Elling!  Hullo Elaine!  Let me have a wheel of bleu cheese, eh?
Hip hip, hoorah!
Quite the riveting tale.  Now I know why there was so much dust on that book.
%s holds the limp body of Taelan Fordring and softly sobs.
Tell me of Drek'Thar.
Auction House
He'll bring you mead, he'll bring you beer...

Yes, yes, calm down, $c, there's nothing to worry about. As luck would have it, when you first gave the left piece to me, I attuned myself to it, so summoning it back from wherever you 'misplaced' it is really not a problem.$B$BHere, and this time try to take better care of it.
Feugen make master happy.
For the Legion! For Kil'Jaeden!

The Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon is a state-of-the-art single person projectile device. Delivering its payload at near the speed of a dragon, the cannon is the pride and joy of the Blastenheimer family, world renown for their aeronautical and combustible feats!$B$BIf you'd like to be launched through the skies to fly free as a bird, seek out Maxima Blastenheimer on the east end of the faire. I hear that she's placed a target ring way over on Crystal Lake for you to aim for as you sail through the air!
I will teach you what I can.
There is no victory for you here! What little ground you've gained will be swallowed by the Scourge army in due course!
Only those who have proven themselves to not be hostile toward the Timbermaw may pass through the Hold without fear of being attacked.  Have you made an effort to earn our trust, outsider?
My dear Staffron, have you forgotten what it is to love? The love that we once shared?
Our new allies will avenge us!

Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the Darkspear, then you can start by donating valuable resources for those in need!  Textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know.$B$BRather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the Darkspear!
Not bad... I suppose training you is not out of the question. Very well! Let's begin...
Alexstrazsa, the Life-Binder. A magnificent creature.
You put the piece on a minnow and placed the minnow somewhere in the waters of the sea between here and the Eastern Kingdoms? And this minnow has special powers?
Trying to find out more about my predicament has been nearly impossible.  The smuggler that hired us has vanished and Anthion Harmon, our mercenary company's leader, is dead.
Now is the time to attack!  For the Horde!
A paladin! Slaying him would please the master. Attack!
%s gets to one knee.
Tell me of Captain Galvangar.
So you suspect that someone on the inside was involved? They were tipped off?
Footmen, make a line!
$n has defended the lumber mill!
Antonio Perelli's miracle elixirs for sale!
%s nods his head at $n, and sighs thoughtfully.

That reminds me, I'm going to need to find something to eat soon. As to what the Alliance has been cooking up, I'm told that $2092w out of $2093w rainbow fin albacore have been packed away. As well, $2098w of $2099w roast raptor and $2101w out of $2103w spotted yellowtail have been prepared and are currently in cold storage awaiting transport to Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

What I offer to you now is one such blade, unfired, unheated, untreated - the most raw and basic form.$B$BNow you merely need to find a dragon that will willingly enchant the blade.$B$BIf you had an eternity to live, this might be a possibility; but since you are mortal and could very likely cease to exist at any moment, might I recommend trying to persuade one of the lesser dragons to do your bidding.
I'm saved! Thank you, doctor!

Are you daft? Did you miss the BONY SKELETAL CREATURES littering the landscape on your way over here?$B$B<Rohan sighs.>$B$BIf you're the outdoor type, you'll find skeletal creatures all over both the Western and Eastern Plaguelands. Trust me, you can't miss 'em - they certainly won't miss you if they get the chance.$B$BIf you're a dungeon type, Stratholme and Scholomance are definitely the place to be for bone fragments.
How are my men doing?

Omen sleeps in the depths of Lake Elune'ara, but may be summoned at the southeast banks near the Stormrage Barrow Dens.  There, you will find special cluster launchers...$B$BUse your rockets in the launchers and Omen's minions will come.  Fire more rockets, nearly three dozen, or fire Elune's candles at his minions, and soon he will awaken.
I welcome you back, $n.
Official business, John. I need some information about Marshal Windsor. Tell me about the last time you saw him.
Yes? I have a breastplate to finish so this had better be good.
The final charge is set. Stand back!
Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.
Act quick! Once it's gone, it's gone! Get your weapons here now!

I've got a lot going on out here in Desolace, $N. Roetten wants us to pick up some reagents for one of our clients as well as fetch some of these lost items.$B$BSeein' as you're here to help out, why don't we get started?
%s points to the parchment on the ground.

Another fine day in the jungle!  It's going to be quite a hunt, I can feel it.  Once Barnil is done cleaning the guns, I'm taking the hunting party deep into the twisting vines.  Not such a bad way for an old war vet to spend his retirement, eh?
%s emerges from the shadows to defend the cauldron!
